thread:
maria: Heads up — multiple Dedicated customers in na-south reporting 5xxs + extreme tail latency since ~08:20 UTC. acct-8472 seeing placement failures and repeated router 429s.
jamie: Oncall here, checking autoscaler and router traces. Any quick logs or job ids?
maria: Pasting snippets:
```
job_id=scale-2026-04-15T08:21Z-NA-SOUTH-77
[2026-04-15T08:22:05Z] placement_failed tenant=acct-8472 model=redwood-large-v1 req_id=xxx reason=no_available_gpus
[2026-04-15T08:22:06Z] router: 429 rate_limited route=/v1/generate tenant=acct-8472
```
harry: grabbing pool util now. Do we see noisy tenants or preemptions?
maria: Support logs show a bunch of retry storms from several clients after 429s. Billing reported elevated token counts for some tenants.
harry: na-south GPU pool at ~98% allocated. I see repeated preemptible reclaim events and one tenant acct-9902 running >2x expected slot usage — looks like a runaway job. Kicking cgroup caps.
anna: Autoscaler requested +6 A100-80G but cloud returned 'resource pool exhausted in region na-south'. We have capacity in na-west but routing currently blocks cross-region fallback due to auth transfer error: 'auth: token expired for region-transfer'.
ops-ryan: I'm reissuing region tokens for Dedicated tenants, pushing a config to relax strict same-region preference. Will verify routing tests.
maria: Customer acct-8472 is seeing 500s in prod and asking for an ETA. They're also worried about billing spikes from retries.
jamie: Short-term plan: (1) cap noisy tenant acct-9902 (harry) (2) enable cross-region failover to na-west (ops-ryan + anna) (3) set router circuit-breaker to 503 on placement failures to avoid retry storms (me).
harry: Applied caps, reclaimed ~3 GPUs. Early telemetry: tail latency dropped from ~1.2s down to ~240ms for multiple tenants.
anna: Cross-region token reissue complete for impacted Dedicated tenants; routing tests to na-west pass. Deploying routing/fallback change to na-south now. Need to confirm billing attribution for failover traffic.
lucas: Sales here — acct-8472 blocked in prod. Please keep me posted; I'll start the customer comms and escalate credits if needed.
maria: Repro steps added to ticket: 1) send 70rps steady to /v1/generate tenant=acct-8472 model=redwood-large-v1; 2) watch router 429s and autoscaler state 'pending' in autoscaler logs; 3) cloud returns 'resource pool exhausted' and placement_failed. Logs attached to the internal ticket.
jamie: Initial incident classification: regional GPU depletion + autoscaler quota behavior + cross-region auth bug -> placement failures -> client retry storms -> tail latency and billing noise.
deploy-bot: deploy: routing/fallback-relax v1.2.3 released to na-south at 2026-04-15T09:05Z :rocket:
maria: Customer confirmed reduced errors at 09:12 UTC after failover; monitoring continues. Will close escalation after 2h stable.
harry: Follow-ups: add autoscaler alert for 'scale_up pending >2m', add playbook for noisy-tenant cgroup caps, and add test for region-transfer token rotation.
jamie: Starting postmortem draft and will assign owners. :thumbsup:
